full_name: Hanchao Lu | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 History William Bentinck-Smith Fellow Georgia Institute of Technology
bio: Hanchao Lu is a professor of history at the Georgia Institute of Technology and an honorary senior research professor at the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences. His research interests include the socioeconomic and cultural history of modern China, Chinese urban history, and everyday life studies.
